description: Our aim is keeping astronauts healthy, millions of miles from the nearest hospital. We turn wearable biometric data into early warnings, so crews can act before a small symptom becomes a mission-threatening problem.
summary:
We developed health monitoring software, which you daily input your health data, take some eye and finger point tests, and what you ate that day.
program analyses that data, and tells which parts of your body needs attention, through a representative body, and gives you tasks and advises associated with it, it has built in Astra AI, to check your stress level, review today's meal(and tells what you should eat tomorrow), and answer your questions
details:
for opening the project:
1. download it from google drives
2. unzip/extract all files
3.double click the file "Start-Astro-Care.cmd"
4. double click index.html file


the project is made in html, CSS, and javascript
we coded in VS code.
we used "chat gpt" as SI.

our tool could count as creative because it has a representative body to show your health issues and health status, it has built in Astro AI to assist you, and it has eye test, colorblind test, finger point test, and that kind of useful tests to collect data and analyse it for giving you support

Astro-Care’s Radiation panel flags recent solar particle events. It pulls reports from NASA’s DONKI space-weather database and checks when the latest event was reported.
